name: Bottle Machine 64 app (new product)
machine: Bottle Machine 64 (rotary-disk unscrambler) + 10-part Mini Sorter test machine
what it is: The per-machine app being built now: the client uploads a STEP assembly + a BOM, the app checks them (exact matching, no guessing), asks you to confirm part types and drive links and to type the numbers, then builds a wireframe, one folder of generated code per part, simulated fault-current tables and a rulebook. The code is generic: the machine is only the input.
how to run: cd bottle_machine_64 && .venv/bin/python app/server.py  ->  http://localhost:8792   (Formula Flow dashboard: /flow?name=mini_sorter)

name: Formula candidates (staging)
what it is: Stages cited formulas (OpenStax/Wikipedia) outside the engine: checks units with sympy, removes ones already in the engine, writes pilot_100.json/csv.

name: Core formula engine (Yanthros Formula Brain)
what it is: The physics formula library and the service that chains formulas together. formulas.py holds the sympy symbols and the FORMULAS dictionary; brain.py builds a graph of which variables connect through which formulas and finds a path from known values to a target.
how to run: python3 brain.py  (service on port 5051)  -  warning: build_graph() rewrites brain_graph.json

name: YANTHROS CORE (copy of the engine)
what it is: Second copy of brain.py + formulas.py from Sep 17-18 (same files as F03). Its brain_graph.json is a different, older, larger file.

name: PROTOTYPE_BACKUP: engine copy
what it is: Frozen copy taken 2026-10-03 before the zero-guess work (see PROTOTYPE_BACKUP_2026-10-03/README.txt). Same disk as the original.

name: License prototype: Software Packet Builder + dashboard
machine: Machine-independent (demo used a bottle-machine component subset)
what it is: The first version of the product idea: a GUI that takes the minimum machine data (or a STEP file), selects a formula subset, generates a current-signature database, and wraps it in a signed license so the client's app can unlock only what was paid for. Also the local admin dashboard for the core engine (graph explorer, solver). Contains the ESP32 defaults and assumed constants that the new app removed.
how to run: python3 packet_builder_app.py   |   python3 dashboard/app.py  (dashboard on port 5090)

name: PROTOTYPE_BACKUP: license prototype copy
what it is: Frozen copy of F06 from 2026-10-03.

name: Servo Piston Filler twin
machine: Volumetric Technologies Servo Piston Filler / Depositor
what it is: A 3D wireframe twin of one filling machine, built by hand from the formula engine: build_twin.py computes values into twin_data.json, index.html shows them.
how to run: python3 build_twin.py, then open index.html (or python3 -m http.server)

name: Bottle unscrambler schematic twin
what it is: A single self-contained page drawing the unscrambler as a schematic 3D twin.

name: Twin Forge
machine: Any machine; research examples: centrifugal pump (Goulds/Xylem NPE), ROBOWAY gearmotor
what it is: The Servo Piston Filler process turned repeatable: take a machine, drive the formula brain, produce a verified 3D twin. engine/ is the template, research/ holds two worked examples, pipeline-ui/ is a React page that shows the pipeline steps.

name: 150 RPM gear system (the prototype that worked live)
machine: 150 RPM metal internal gearbox, 12 V motor, ESP32 + INA228
what it is: Flask app (port 5053): 3D twin, physics formula chain, calibration, and the live 'Part Interruption' detection that reads motor current from an ESP32 + INA228 over USB serial and names which gear was touched.

name: GearTwinLive iPad app
what it is: Standalone Swift app: talks to the ESP32 over Bluetooth, detects touches on-device, shows the 3D twin. Currently runs against a built-in simulated sensor. Paused.

name: GearTwinDashboard iPad app
what it is: Minimal SwiftUI shell: a full-screen web view pointed at the Flask dashboard plus an address settings sheet. Paused.

name: Gear prototype read-only copy (inside bottle_machine_64)
what it is: Copy made on 2026-10-06 so the new app's validation can read the framework without touching the original.

name: Zinaata Android + backend + Dorus
what it is: The same method applied to consumer electronics: Android app (Kotlin) scans phone hardware, a Python backend (relays to Supabase) receives scans, the DORUSSS engine and an RL diagnosis pipeline analyse them, plus a browser prototype.
how to run: backend: python3 backend/server.py   |   RL: see rl_diagnosis/DORUSSS_REPORT.md

name: Zinaata macOS app
what it is: SwiftUI Mac app: chat UI, Mac hardware snapshot via system tools, optional AI API client; scripts/watcher.sh runs as a background agent.

name: BMS-faulter (business management site)
what it is: Small React + Node app: accounts and transactions pages, database_schema.sql, server.js. Local only (no .git here; a GitHub repo of the same name exists).

name: Yanthros_fresh (July 31 snapshot)
machine: 150 RPM gear system, RS-775 DC motor + tyre demo, Cybertruck 130-size DC motor, ESP32
what it is: The old all-in-one Yanthros: the core engine plus per-machine files side by side. app.py alone is about 12,000 lines (routes for every machine). Identical to F19.

name: Archive copy of Yanthros_fresh
what it is: Byte-for-byte copy of F18 (23 of 23 code files identical).

name: Archive: YANTHROS (earliest)
what it is: One HTML page plus motor physics notes (markdown, not listed).

name: Archive: YANTHROS v2
machine: 150 RPM gear system, RS-775 DC motor + tyre demo, Cybertruck, ESP32
what it is: Later version of the old all-in-one. app.py is about 13,400 lines. Includes the BVS calibration engine, the 'Magenta' simulator and a React fault dashboard. Contains a file named openai.key (not opened by this report).

name: FAULTER-EI (Nassenger 8 twin with agents)
machine: Konica Minolta Nassenger 8 industrial inkjet textile printer
what it is: First big twin of the printer: FastAPI WebSocket server, an agent layer (core/), formula pathfinder, and many UI versions (3D twin v1/v2 + dated backups, website, JARVIS console).

name: Archive: faulter (formula deck)
what it is: One HTML formula deck page.

name: DIVINE: faulter-wireless
what it is: ESP32 WiFi sketch + dashboard_server.py + a nested copy of the 17 'worker' station pages (unwinder, feed, tensioning ... control).

name: DIVINE: faulter (index page)
what it is: One index.html.

name: DIVINE: faulter-software (Nassenger 8 neuro-symbolic twin)
what it is: One HTML page per printer station ('worker'): unwinder, feed, tensioning, flattening, carriage, printhead, ink supply, nozzle health, head height, capping, RIP, dryer, rewinder, belt washing, environmental, maintenance, control. Built from a shared template (about 45% of lines shared between pages).

name: faulter-app (node-graph calculator)
what it is: FastAPI backend + React flow editor where formula nodes are wired together and calculated.

name: dumpyard/faulter: AC-motor twin + Node-RED universal twin
machine: AC motor; Nassenger 8; 'any machine' (EV bike, drone...)
what it is: Two experiments: ac-motor-digital-twin (backend + React) and nodered-digital-twin (Node-RED flows, a formula engine and a 'universal' engine for any machine type, JARVIS console). Node-RED default settings.js files are third-party defaults.
